question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
-- Final query with all years where data is available
WITH last_race AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) AS last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
ranked_drivers AS (
    SELECT r.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points AS driver_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY ds.points DESC) AS rn
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN last_race lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
),
ranked_constructors AS (
    SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, cs.points AS constructor_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY cs.points DESC) AS rn
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN last_race lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
)
SELECT 
    rd.year,
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
    rd.driver_points,
    c.name AS constructor_name,
    rc.constructor_points
FROM ranked_drivers rd
JOIN drivers d ON rd.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN ranked_constructors rc ON rd.year = rc.year
JOIN constructors c ON rc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE rd.rn = 1 AND rc.rn = 1
ORDER BY rd.year
